title: What's new in Jellydash v1.2.0
summary: Jellydash can now run with SQLite, giving new installations a lighter option with one container and one database file.
highlights: New installations can choose SQLite instead of running a separate MariaDB container.
Already using MariaDB? Nothing changes, and you do not need to migrate.
If you want to switch, Jellydash includes an optional migration that verifies every copied value and leaves the original MariaDB database untouched.
